note: Additional recordings found after the first benchmark was frozen. Kept in a separate manifest so the first manifest and its freeze stay untouched. Development-2 can inform choices; test-2 is frozen separately (FREEZE-2.json) and evaluated once. Both are tiny: read the counts.

annotation.method: Manual review of raw decoded frames (0.3 to 5 s apart) with only the zone outline drawn. Intervals are visibility intervals.
annotation.reviewer_note: One reviewer (the implementing assistant), not expert consensus. Not blind to the application's behaviour.
annotation.temporal_match: same event type and zone, temporal IoU >= 0.5, one-to-one

limits: Only recordings that pass the fixed-camera test, have a CC0 / public-domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA licence on Wikimedia Commons, and contain nothing violent or sensitive were considered. Most search results failed one of these.
Roncesvalles: one annotated pedestrian event; the queued vehicles are not annotated because their stationarity cannot be judged reliably from the frames.
Washington DC crosswalk: a near-empty street. It contributes negative video time only (no annotated positives).

Roundabout (test-2): an aerial view with only vehicles. It adds negative video time for persons and nothing else: no positives are annotated, so recall on test-2 is undefined. It was chosen and its zone fixed BEFORE any detector ran on it.
